[[Trioculus]] maintained his own '''palace''' on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] since his promotion to [[Lord Overseer]] and [[Supreme Slavelord]] of the Spice Mines. A large, sleek building made of [[Color/Legends|black]] metal, the palace notably contained a banquet hall, a huge kitchen and the Lord Overseer's private chambers. When Trioculus sought to succeed the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as leader of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he summoned the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs|Central Committee]] of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]] for a celebration banquet. It is unknown what was made of the palace after his [[Death/Legends|death]] on the [[Moffship]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].
